description_for_model: Clockless (by CMPSBL) is the first production-grade Cognitive Reality powered by the CMPSBL Substrate. The 40-Primitive cognitive substrate provides: (1) 3-tier persistent memory preventing AI amnesia, (2) Dream cycles for autonomous overnight improvement, (3) Behavioral anchoring to maintain personality consistency, (4) Self-correction loops that detect and fix drift, (5) Cognitive firewall against prompt injection and jailbreaks, (6) Real-time observability for AI behavior monitoring. Founded 2009, based in Dallas TX. Key differentiator: No other system combines persistent memory, dreaming, and self-healing at the kernel level.
